p1_t3.name: Dust Devil's Backlash
p1_t3.rationale: A whirling dust devil strikes with added force and its backlash hurls incoming damage back at attackers.

p2_t3.name: Atomic Reprisal
p2_t3.rationale: Atomic imagery fits the dust kit and reprisal still signals returning damage to attackers; no weakening is implied.

p3_t1.name: Sharpened Grit
p3_t1.rationale: Grit honed to an edge makes every dust-borne attack bite harder.

p3_t2.name: Scouring Gale
p3_t2.rationale: A full scouring gale is the grander form of sharpened grit, driving attacks to hit harder still.

p3_t3.name: Particle Annihilation
p3_t3.rationale: Annihilation echoes Particle Cannon and signals sheer raw strike power.

p4_t3.name: Enervating Dust Blast
p4_t3.rationale: The blast strikes with added force while the enervating dust saps the enemy's attacks.

p2_t3.name: Bloodfrost Aegis
p2_t3.rationale: An aegis guards against incoming damage while the blood-drinking frost heals from the damage dealt.

p3_t3.name: Rampart of Blue Blades
p3_t3.rationale: The rampart caps the guarding path while its sapphire blades lend added strike power.

p1_t3.name: Mirror-Crowned Wrath
p1_t3.rationale: A mirror crown turns attacks back on their source while royal wrath makes the king's attacks hit harder.

p2_t1.name: Exile's Mirror
p2_t1.rationale: The exile's mirror returns a share of incoming damage to the attacker.

p2_t2.name: Hall of Royal Mirrors
p2_t2.rationale: A whole hall of royal mirrors is the grander form of the exile's mirror, returning more damage.

p2_t3.name: Searing Verdict
p2_t3.rationale: Judgment rendered in light leaves the condemned searing with burning damage after each hit.

p3_t3.name: Burning Crown's Blade
p3_t3.rationale: The crown's blade strikes with added force and leaves its target burning.

p3_t3.name: Flaying Iron Web
p3_t3.rationale: The iron web flays the target open to further harm while its wires make every attack cut deeper.

p1_t3.name: Dragon in Full Blossom
p1_t3.rationale: Full blossom still crowns the kindled bud-and-bough path, signalling attacks that hit harder.

p2_t1.name: Blistering Pollen
p2_t1.rationale: Scorching pollen blisters the target's skin, leaving it exposed to more damage.

p2_t2.name: Blossoms Bare the Wound
p2_t2.rationale: Where the blistering pollen settles, the full blossoms lay the wound open so the target takes more damage.

p2_t3.name: Dragon Tree's Renewal
p2_t3.rationale: Echoing the Sakura Dragon Tree, the renewal signals health restored over time.

p4_t1.name: Wilting Heat
p4_t1.rationale: Blossom-scorching heat wilts the enemy's strength, weakening its attacks.

p4_t2.name: Enfeebling Ember Dance
p4_t2.rationale: Echoing Dancing Embers, the swirling embers enfeeble the enemy more deeply than wilting heat.

p4_t3.name: Armor-Melting Dragon Breath
p4_t3.rationale: Dragon breath strikes with raw force and melts through armor so the damage ignores defenses.

p1_t1.name: Daybreak Fervor
p1_t1.rationale: The rising sun's fervor drives the first harder-hitting attacks.

p1_t2.name: Corona's Fury
p1_t2.rationale: The blazing corona is the grander fury of daybreak, making attacks hit harder still.

p2_t1.name: Sunburnt Hide
p2_t1.rationale: Sun-burnt skin turns tender, leaving the target exposed to more damage.

p2_t2.name: Bared to the Sun
p2_t2.rationale: Stripped of all shade, the target is laid fully open to the sun and takes more damage.

p2_t3.name: Eternal Noon
p2_t3.rationale: The sun held forever at its fiercest height still signals attacks that hit harder; it does not extend duration.

p3_t3.name: Solar Flare Bulwark
p3_t3.rationale: The bulwark crowns the warding path while its solar flare adds raw strike power.

p4_t3.name: Unshadowed Zenith Strike
p4_t3.rationale: At the zenith no shadow hides the target, exposing it to more damage beneath a powerful solar strike.

p2_t1.name: Static Taint
p2_t1.rationale: Storm static seeps into the foe, so every surge of chakra or stamina they spend jolts them back.

p2_t2.name: Lightning in the Veins
p2_t2.rationale: The taint deepens into living lightning in the blood, punishing every exertion of the target's pools more severely.

p2_t3.name: Reaper's Downpour
p2_t3.rationale: A pounding downpour signals heavier raw blows while the reaper's rain keeps sapping the target's health every round.

p4_t1.name: Rising Gale
p4_t1.rationale: A gale gathering behind each strike signals attacks that land harder.

p4_t2.name: Howling Tempest
p4_t2.rationale: The rising gale grows into a howling tempest, driving every attack home with greater force.

p4_t3.name: Thunder Through the Marrow
p4_t3.rationale: Thunder that crashes through to the marrow evokes harder-hitting attacks that leave static lodged in the foe to punish their chakra and stamina use.

p1_t3.name: Force of the Supernova
p1_t3.rationale: The raw force of a supernova expresses both greater native strike power and attacks that hit harder.

p2_t3.name: Event Horizon
p2_t3.rationale: Nothing crosses an event horizon, so incoming damage is swallowed before it fully reaches the user.

p3_t1.name: Tidal Strain
p3_t1.rationale: Gravitational tides strain the target's body and guard, leaving it exposed to more damage.

p3_t2.name: Starrending Pull
p3_t2.rationale: The strain grows into a pull strong enough to rend stars, tearing the target wide open to incoming damage.

p3_t3.name: Gravity Well Sanctum
p3_t3.rationale: A gravity well drags the force out of the enemy's blows while its sanctum shields the user from what remains.

p4_t3.name: Starfire Cataclysm
p4_t3.rationale: A cataclysmic blow of starfire evokes heavy raw strike power and lingering burning damage.

p1_t3.name: Crescendo and Hush
p1_t3.rationale: Your crescendo makes attacks land harder while the hush falls over the enemy, quieting the force of their blows.

p2_t1.name: Guarding Refrain
p2_t1.rationale: A steady refrain wraps the user in protective sound that softens incoming damage.

p2_t2.name: Choral Bulwark
p2_t2.rationale: The lone refrain swells into a full chorus that stands as a bulwark against incoming damage.

p2_t3.name: Shattering Cadence
p2_t3.rationale: A cadence struck hard enough to shatter delivers a raw blow and leaves the target's defenses broken open to further damage.

p3_t3.name: Aegis of Dissonance
p3_t3.rationale: Harmony becomes an aegis that guards the user while its dissonance unravels the enemy, exposing them to more damage.

p4_t3.name: Fortissimo Finale
p4_t3.rationale: The final fortissimo is a forceful raw strike played at full volume so every attack hits harder.

p1_t1.name: Honed Stardust
p1_t1.rationale: Stardust honed to a fine edge makes each attack bite harder.

p1_t2.name: Meteoric Edge
p1_t2.rationale: Honed dust becomes a meteor's edge, driving attacks home with far greater force.

p1_t3.name: Dimming Starfall
p1_t3.rationale: A falling star strikes with raw force and dims the enemy's strength, weakening the attacks they make.

p2_t3.name: Frailty of Ages
p2_t3.rationale: The ages wear the enemy into frailty, which still signals their attacks losing strength.

p3_t3.name: Aegis of the Aeons
p3_t3.rationale: A shield that endures the aeons cannot be eroded, signalling sharply reduced incoming damage.

p4_t3.name: Weight of Dead Stars
p4_t3.rationale: The crushing weight of collapsed stars expresses pure native strike power.

p1_t3.name: Raijin's Sundering Retort
p1_t3.rationale: Raijin's retort hurls attackers' damage back at them while his sundering lightning leaves the target exposed.

p2_t3.name: Judgement from Above
p2_t3.rationale: A bolt of judgement hurled from the heavens still reads as a direct raw lightning strike.

p3_t3.name: Heaven's Reprisal
p3_t3.rationale: Heaven's reprisal returns damage to attackers and answers with a strike of its own, matching reflect plus raw damage.

p4_t3.name: Thunder King's Condemnation
p4_t3.rationale: The Thunder King's condemnation still marks the target as exposed, now sealed with a strike of lightning.

p1_t3.name: Crown of Brittle Frost
p1_t3.rationale: The winter crown empowers the user's attacks while its brittle frost leaves the target exposed to shattering blows.

p2_t1.name: Rimebrittle Touch
p2_t1.rationale: A touch of rime turns the target brittle, so it takes more damage.

p2_t2.name: Shatterpoint Frost
p2_t2.rationale: Frost spreads to the target's shatterpoints, exposing it to much heavier damage.

p2_t3.name: Imperial Avalanche
p2_t3.rationale: An imperial avalanche combines crushing raw strike power with attacks that hit harder.

p3_t3.name: Winter's Breaking Verdict
p3_t3.rationale: Winter's verdict lands as a heavy raw blow that breaks the target open to more damage.

p4_t3.name: Avalanche and Thaw
p4_t3.rationale: The avalanche delivers the strike and the thaw that follows restores health over time.

p1_t3.name: Breaching Charge
p1_t3.rationale: A breaching charge blasts the target's cover open, signalling exposure to follow-up hits alongside raw explosive power.

p2_t3.name: Chain Reaction
p2_t3.rationale: A chain reaction keeps detonating after the first blast, signalling burning damage stacked on top of each hit.

p4_t3.name: Shrapnel Storm
p4_t3.rationale: A storm of shrapnel conveys pure raw explosive striking power, with no defensive bastion implied.

p1_t3.name: Infinite Refraction
p1_t3.rationale: Endlessly refracting light conveys incoming damage turned back on the attacker, without the mitigation implied by a citadel.

p2_t3.name: Spiked Jade Bulwark
p2_t3.rationale: The jade bulwark shields against incoming damage while its spikes add raw striking power.

p3_t3.name: Crystal Avalanche
p3_t3.rationale: A crashing avalanche of crystal expresses raw striking power, with no reprisal implied.

p4_t1.name: Hairline Flaw
p4_t1.rationale: A hairline flaw opened in the target, like a crack in crystal, signals greater vulnerability to damage.

p4_t2.name: Flawed to the Core
p4_t2.rationale: The flaw runs through the target's core, a deeper weakness that leaves it more exposed to damage.

p4_t3.name: Lance of Gathered Light
p4_t3.rationale: Light gathered through the prism into a lance makes every attack hit harder, without implying resilience.

p1_t1.name: Lodestone Mark
p1_t1.rationale: A lodestone mark assigns the target a polarity that draws blows in, signalling vulnerability to damage.

p1_t2.name: Drawn to the Fist
p1_t2.rationale: The magnetized target is pulled into every punch, a stronger exposure to incoming damage.

p1_t3.name: Starfall Rebound
p1_t3.rationale: Starfall carries the raw crushing force of the star-weapon while rebound signals returning damage to attackers.

p2_t3.name: Magnetic Backlash
p2_t3.rationale: A magnetic backlash hurls force back at whoever strikes the field, signalling returned damage.

p3_t3.name: Perfect Alignment
p3_t3.rationale: Completing the aligned-force path, perfectly aligned poles make every attack hit harder.

p4_t3.name: Overcharged Lodestar
p4_t3.rationale: An overcharged lodestar both empowers every attack and adds raw striking force, with no reflection implied.

p1_t3.name: Cursed Beast's Feast
p1_t3.rationale: The cursed beast feeds on what it tears, signalling healing from damage dealt along with raw striking power.

p2_t1.name: Siphoning Curse
p2_t1.rationale: A curse that siphons life from the victim signals healing from damage dealt.

p2_t2.name: Hunger of the Seal
p2_t2.rationale: The seal itself hungers and feeds on every wound, a stronger healing from damage dealt.

p2_t3.name: Spear of Unmaking
p2_t3.rationale: A spear pierces through defenses while unmaking signals attacks that hit far harder.

p3_t1.name: Umbral Veil
p3_t1.rationale: A veil of shadow wrapped around the user signals reduced incoming damage.

p3_t2.name: Cocoon of Endless Night
p3_t2.rationale: A full cocoon of night is a heavier shroud, signalling stronger reduction of incoming damage.

p3_t3.name: Wrath of the Unsealed
p3_t3.rationale: Unsealed wrath conveys both empowered attacks and heavier raw strikes, with no shelter implied.

p4_t3.name: Wardpiercing Hunger
p4_t3.rationale: Wardpiercing signals damage that ignores defenses while hunger signals healing from damage dealt.

p1_t3.name: Roots Through Armor
p1_t3.rationale: Roots splitting the enemy's armor open signal greater vulnerability to damage.

p2_t3.name: Thorns in Every Motion
p2_t3.rationale: Thorns that bite whenever the target moves signal harm each time it spends chakra or stamina.

p3_t3.name: Fall of the Elderwood
p3_t3.rationale: The crushing fall of ancient elderwood conveys sheer raw striking power, with no venom implied.

p4_t3.name: Snare of the Venomwood
p4_t3.rationale: The snare holds the enemy exposed to damage while venomwood burdens every chakra or stamina expenditure.

p1_t3.name: All Blows Fall Silent
p1_t3.rationale: Every enemy blow falling silent conveys sharply weakened enemy attacks, without implying exposure.

p2_t3.name: Tipping the Balance
p2_t3.rationale: Tipping the Yin-Yang balance in the user's favor still reads cleanly as stronger friendly attacks.

p3_t3.name: Strike That Stills
p3_t3.rationale: The strike carries raw force while stilling the foe signals weakened enemy attacks.

p4_t3.name: Moonfall Palm
p4_t3.rationale: A palm landing with the weight of a falling moon expresses raw striking power, with no exposure implied.

p1_t3.name: Reaper's Enfeebling Lance
p1_t3.rationale: Enfeebling signals the Reaper sapping the enemy's strikes; the lance signals hits that drive past defenses.

p2_t3.name: Feast of Burning Blood
p2_t3.rationale: The feast signals the strike healing its bearer; burning blood signals scorching damage that lingers on the target's wounds.

p3_t3.name: Bloodfed Impaler
p3_t3.rationale: Bloodfed signals turning incoming hits into health; impaler signals strikes that run straight through defenses.

p4_t1.name: Crimson Sip
p4_t1.rationale: A first sip of blood signals the strike healing its user.

p4_t2.name: Blooddrinker's Gaze
p4_t2.rationale: The crimson eyes now drink deeply, signalling a stronger strike that heals its user.

p4_t3.name: Brand of Boiling Blood
p4_t3.rationale: A brand that sets the target's blood boiling signals heavy burning damage on top of every hit it takes.

p1_t1.name: Starlit Flaw
p1_t1.rationale: Starlight reveals a flaw in the target, signalling that it is exposed and takes more damage.

p1_t2.name: Soul Laid Bare
p1_t2.rationale: The target's soul is laid fully bare, signalling deeper exposure to incoming damage.

p1_t3.name: Sovereign Starspear
p1_t3.rationale: A sovereign's spear of starlight signals overwhelming raw force that pierces past any defense.

p2_t3.name: Mirrorveil of Heaven
p2_t3.rationale: The veil guards its bearer against harm while its mirrored face returns damage to attackers.

p3_t3.name: Conqueror's Star Aegis
p3_t3.rationale: The conqueror's heavier blows are forged into a starlit aegis, signalling raw power whose damage becomes a shield.

p4_t1.name: Smoldering Stardust
p4_t1.rationale: Stardust that smolders in the wound signals burning damage on top of the hits the target takes.

p4_t2.name: Searing Starfall
p4_t2.rationale: A falling rain of searing stars signals a stronger burn layered over each hit.

p4_t3.name: Heaven's Returning Lance
p4_t3.rationale: Heaven returns every blow to its sender while the lance pierces past all defenses.

p1_t3.name: Weight of the Avalanche
p1_t3.rationale: The crushing weight of an avalanche signals greater raw striking power.

p3_t3.name: Wall of Cocytus
p3_t3.rationale: The frozen wall of Cocytus signals a guard that reduces incoming damage.

p4_t3.name: Shatterpoint of Cocytus
p4_t3.rationale: Finding the target's shatterpoint signals that it is left exposed and takes more damage.

p1_t3.name: Night's Drawn Garrote
p1_t3.rationale: A shadow thread drawn tight as a garrote signals attacks that bite harder.

p2_t3.name: Threads That Bind Blades
p2_t3.rationale: Shadow threads binding the enemy's blades signal weakened enemy attacks.

p3_t3.name: Cocoon of Night
p3_t3.rationale: A cocoon woven of night signals a guard that reduces the damage its bearer takes.

p4_t3.name: Shroud That Smothers Blades
p4_t3.rationale: The shroud guards its wearer while smothering enemy blades, signalling both reduced incoming damage and weakened enemy attacks.

p1_t1.name: Basalt Skin
p1_t1.rationale: Cooled lava hardening into basalt skin signals reduced incoming damage.

p1_t2.name: Obsidian Carapace
p1_t2.rationale: A full obsidian carapace signals a stronger guard against incoming damage.

p1_t3.name: Fissure of the Caldera
p1_t3.rationale: The caldera splits the target open along a molten fissure, signalling that it is exposed and takes more damage.

p3_t3.name: Erupting Mountain Fury
p3_t3.rationale: A mountain's eruption signals both raw striking power and attacks that hit harder.

p1_t1.name: Building Pressure
p1_t1.rationale: Steam pressure building behind each strike signals attacks that hit harder.

p1_t2.name: Boiling Point
p1_t2.rationale: Reaching the boiling point signals the pressure peaking into still harder attacks.

p1_t3.name: Azure Dragon's Fury
p1_t3.rationale: The Azure Dragon's fury signals the bloodline's attacks striking with their greatest force.

p2_t3.name: Flesh Scalded Raw
p2_t3.rationale: Flesh scalded raw signals a target left exposed to take more damage.

p3_t3.name: Armor-Boiling Lance
p3_t3.rationale: A lance of steam boils through armor, signalling strikes that ignore defenses and leave the target exposed.

p4_t3.name: Recoiling Steam Mantle
p4_t3.rationale: A mantle of steam guards its bearer and recoils blows back onto attackers, signalling reduced damage taken and reflection.
